title: Ask about this meeting
scope: This meeting only. Your conversation is private; personal notes and other folders are not used.
pending: Reading sources and preparing the result…
error: The conversation or request could not be confirmed. Reload the conversation before retrying.
empty: Ask a question about what was discussed in this meeting.
question: Your question about this meeting

result.unavailable: This result is no longer readable under current permissions and source versions.
result.abstention: The available sources do not support an answer with sufficient confidence.
result.proposal: Proposal for review. No publication, task or communication is triggered. Edits remain in this view.
result.failed: Copy failed. You can select and copy the text.
result.failure: Generation failed for a technical reason. This does not mean evidence is absent.
result.processing: This request is still processing. Reload the conversation to check its current state.
result.unknown: The outcome of this request remains unknown. A new question or proposal will create a separate request without retrying this one.
result.refusal: This request cannot be processed within the authorized scope.
result.subject: Subject

source.title: Cited passage
source.loading: Checking the passage and your access…
source.error: This passage cannot be opened. Permissions or the source may have changed.

state.partial: Sources are partial; information may be missing.

selection.relevant_passages: Relevant passages selected; coverage is not exhaustive.
selection.distributed_passages: Passages sampled across the meeting; coverage is not exhaustive.

coverage.unknown: Source coverage could not be established.

prompt.summary: Produce a short summary of this meeting, citing the available sources.
prompt.actions: Extract the proposed actions from this meeting. Include owners and deadlines only when established.
prompt.email_draft: Prepare a follow-up email draft for this meeting with references to cited evidence, without inventing recipients.

command.unconfirmed: The outcome of this request is not confirmed. Read the thread again before retrying.
command.conflict: The thread changed in another session. Check the displayed state before confirming a new request.
command.rejected: The request was rejected. Check its content before trying again.

delete.title: Delete your conversation?
delete.description: This deletes your private thread for this meeting. The summary, folder and personal notes are kept.
